purpose: Treatment-event registry for QUASI_EXPERIMENTS.md design 1 (eligibility-system migration event studies). Dates are recorded at the precision the cited public sources support; nothing here is inferred from memory.

confidence_levels.verified_multi_source: date corroborated by two or more independent public sources
confidence_levels.verified_single_source: date from one credible public source; corroboration pending
confidence_levels.candidate_unverified: event known to exist; dates not yet verified from public records

panel_note: The unblocked outcome panel runs FY2017-FY2024 (analysis/coding_consistency.json). panel_position classifies each event's go-live relative to it; edge events have post-periods in-panel but pre-periods requiring FY2016-or-earlier file acquisition.

events.system: UHIP (Unified Health Infrastructure Project, later RIBridges)
events.notes: Statewide single-cutover go-live after a one-year delay from the original July 2015 plan; application backlog reached ~15,000 at the crisis peak; FNS billed the state $37,343,809.68 for SNAP overpayments covering September 2016 through December 2019 — a federally documented error-consequence window matching the event.

Integrated SNAP/Medicaid platform (~$101.5M); ~25,000 erroneous cancellation notices and a ~50,000-case backlog after launch; state extended SNAP recertification from six to twelve months as a mitigation — itself an error-process-relevant policy response.

Pilot began February 6, 2017 in Henry County with all programs; statewide rollout was phased through 2017 — the statewide completion date is NEEDS_VERIFICATION, and the event-study treatment date should use the phased schedule once verified rather than the pilot date alone.

events.system: ONE Eligibility (expansion to SNAP and other benefit programs)
events.notes: The ONE system originated for Oregon Health Plan eligibility and expanded to other benefit programs in February 2021 — a mid-panel event with full pre- and post-periods in the FY2017-24 window.

events.system: NC FAST (Food and Nutrition Services module)
events.notes: County-level FNS rollout ran May 2012 through March 2013; a July 2013 technical failure slowed processing for over a month and drove a benefits backlog. Pre-panel unless the total-rate panel is extended below FY2017.
A ~$205M modernization reported as beginning in 2022 with replacement of the ~30-year-old eligibility mainframe; phase go-live dates not yet verified from primary sources.
Reported mid-2010s integrated eligibility replacement; dates not yet verified.

events.system: FSSA eligibility modernization (IBM contract, later canceled)
events.notes: 2007-2009 privatized modernization canceled by the state; litigation followed. Pre-panel context only.
2004 go-live widely reported as troubled; pre-panel context only. Relevant because Colorado is the deepest-verified state in this repository.
